name: Mizutani Yoshino
source:
Hobbies: Different kinds of part-time jobs
Likes: Saving money, curry, hamburger steak
Dislikes: Luxury

[url=/c64279]Haruta's[/url] classmate and the student council president of the school. Despite living quite poorly with her father, she always keeps a smile on her face, and is quite skilled at cooking and saving money, being able to live with just 10,000 yen a month. Aside from doing student council work after school, Yoshino also works at part-time jobs like selling beer at a stadium.
